$comment: The faces this app ships, in one place. The deliverable is a single file with no network, so a
font cannot be a <link>: build.js reads each `file`, checks its sha256 and its budget, and inlines
it as a data URI. `brand.json` owns the STACK (which family a role asks for); this file owns the
FILES (what is actually in the bundle) — one fact, one home.
Every face here is ARABIC-ONLY BY SUBSET and says so in `unicodeRange`: Latin runs must keep falling
through to the system stack, or the brand's Latin letterforms would change. That single rule is why
the whole Arabic GUI can be re-typed without touching a component.
`display:true` offers the face to the poster's display roles in RTL only (the `[dir=rtl]` block in
shell.html). `sizeAdjust` is the compensation an Arabic display face needs to hold the same visual
size as the Latin beside it — Jomhuria's ink box is 0.64 em against the fallback's 1.05 em, so it
is measured here rather than guessed in a clamp().
Both mastheads the owner offered are kept in the directory: flip `display` to ship Katibeh instead.

faces.note: Variable: one file carries 200-1000, so `--fw-*` weights are real outlines and no browser emboldens a glyph.
